title: Non-Abelian Thouless pumping based on the global adiabatic criterion in Rydberg synthetic lattices
summary: We study a quantum implementation of non-Abelian Thouless pumping in Lieb lattices using Rydberg synthetic dimensions. The lattice is encoded in twelve selected microwave-coupled Rydberg levels, forming a three-cell structure with six degenerate zero-energy states. These zero-energy states define the working subspace for cyclic modulation of the microwave couplings, while the remaining bright states provide the dominant leakage channels at finite evolution time.
